summary: Pomdoctor filed a 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 30, 2026, describing operational progress in its AI-enabled chronic disease management ecosystem, expanded real-world data (RWD) applications, and integrated in-hospital and out-of-hospital pilot programs. No transaction, price, stake, or board recommendation is disclosed; CEO Zhenyang Shi is quoted on commercialization momentum. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer business update on the Nasdaq-listed company's product roadmap and RWD/RWS revenue initiatives, not a special situation. Watch for future disclosure of monetization metrics or partnership terms, which would be the relevant catalysts.
